# DECISIONS — the archive of what was decided, when and why

### D-001 · 2026-11-01 · Atlas may edit product content
- **Decided by:** owner
- **Decision:** Atlas may rewrite titles, meta descriptions and intros of up to 5 products per day, with snapshot and live verification.
- **Why:** 30 high-impression product pages have CTR below 2% (Search Console, Oct 2026).
- **Applies until:** until superseded
- **Status:** ACTIVE
- **Supersedes:** –

### D-002 · 2026-11-03 · No December discount
- **Decided by:** owner
- **Decision:** No site-wide discount in December. Gift guides instead.
- **Why:** margin target ≥ 55%; last year's 15% discount did not raise order count.
- **Applies until:** 2026-12-31
- **Status:** ACTIVE
- **Supersedes:** –

### D-003 · 2026-11-05 · Pause marketplace stock sync
- **Decided by:** operator (within AUTHORITY: technical)
- **Decision:** Paused the stock-sync job after it set 4 products to 0 stock by mistake; products restored from snapshot.
- **Why:** the sync used a supplier file that was 5 days old.
- **Applies until:** owner reviews the sync source
- **Status:** ACTIVE
- **Supersedes:** –
